name: AI Social Media Automation | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## AI Social Media Automation
**Write** (every Monday): the AI writes each planned post for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X, creates an **AI image** when the row has none, saves the drafts and asks for approval.
**Publish** (every hour): the next approved post is published (one per hour); the result per network is written back.
**Reply** (instantly): comments and messages on your Facebook page and Instagram account get an AI reply in your brand voice. Complaints and anything uncertain are sent to you instead; set `autoReply` to false to approve every reply yourself.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with **Content plan** and **Replies** tabs (CSV files). 3. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets, Gmail, Facebook Graph API (page token) and LinkedIn; X is disabled. 4. For replies, subscribe your Meta app's webhooks (page: feed, messages; Instagram: comments, messages) to the *Meta events* URL with your verify token.
